name: Windows Settings Manager Lite
description:
Put six useful Windows controls on Stream Deck without turning your profile into a giant toolbox.

Windows Settings Manager Lite includes Lock PC, Sleep, live Power Plan, Keep Awake, Previous Desktop, and Next Desktop. The stateful keys re-read Windows instead of assuming PackRat was the last thing to touch the setting.

Keep Awake clearly distinguishes STAY AWAKE from normal Windows sleep behavior. Power Plan can cycle installed plans or target an exact discovered plan. Virtual desktop navigation verifies the resulting Windows desktop state where the operating system exposes it instead of reporting blind hotkey success.

There is no coordinate clicking, hidden mouse movement, or Quick Settings automation. If Windows state cannot be read reliably, PackRat fails closed rather than inventing a state.

Includes editable profiles for Stream Deck, Stream Deck Mini, Stream Deck XL, Stream Deck +, Stream Deck Neo, Galleon 100 SD, and Stream Deck + XL. Pro adds the complete 15-key Windows Control Center with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Hibernate, protected Restart and Shutdown, Light/Dark theme, and full virtual desktop controls.

Requires Windows and Stream Deck 7.3 or later.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes:
- Lock PC and Sleep on Stream Deck.
- Live Power Plan plus clear Stay Awake / Sleep Normal control.
- Previous and Next Windows virtual desktop navigation with state verification where available.
- Editable profiles for seven current Stream Deck device families.
